mapper.sql: select id, player_id, player_index, player_position, player_pk_group, game_item_id, group_index from jw_eight
mapper.select: select * from (select js.id, js.game_item_id, js.player_id, js.player_index, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(js.group_index order by js.id desc),',',1) as description, js.player_position, js.player_pk_group from jw_eight js where js.game_item_id = #{gameItemId} group by js.player_id) aa order by field(aa.description,'季军争夺','季军','冠军争夺', '冠军', '8强', '16强', '32强') asc, aa.player_index
